status: predeclared before model fitting and held-out scoring

split.order: original consecutive row IDs; do not sort local wall-clock timestamps

features.scaling: none; Isolation Forest splits each feature independently
features.missing_policy: no imputation; require all nine channels valid throughout the 15-row feature window
features.fit_policy: only eligible training windows with all 15 original EVENT labels false

threshold_selection.objective: maximize unadjusted point-level F1 among feasible candidates
threshold_selection.tie_break: fewer false-positive minutes, then higher threshold
threshold_selection.candidates: validation score quantiles: 0, 0.5, 0.75; 0.80..0.99 (191 equally spaced); 0.99..1 (201 equally spaced); next float above maximum
threshold_selection.prediction: anomaly_score >= frozen_threshold; no smoothing, debounce, or point adjustment

evaluation.point_labels: original current-row EVENT, never expanded over feature windows
evaluation.point_metrics: eligible rows only, with coverage and unavailable counts reported separately
evaluation.event_definition: contiguous TRUE labels in acquisition order
evaluation.false_alarm_definition: contiguous predicted-positive minutes with original EVENT false, including normal tails
evaluation.event_coverage: any predicted positive inside event; all events retained, including unavailable events
evaluation.new_event_detection: a new alarm run starts inside the event; report separately from coverage
evaluation.delay_units: nominal minutes, among covered/detected events only
evaluation.test_policy: score only after saving model and threshold lock; no test-guided tuning

scope.dataset_limit: drinking-water benchmark with binary events, including simulated challenge events; Cl and Cl_2 are chlorine dioxide, not free residual chlorine
